title: Routing decision - the auditable record of one capability selection
$comment: Phase 8 (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10948-10963). Validates the PAYLOAD produced by `router.Decision.to_dict()`. RELATIONSHIP TO THE SUBSTRATE: command-center/schema/router-explanation.schema.json, router-telemetry.schema.json and router-corpus.schema.json are GENERATED SHIMS that delegate to the receipt control plane and carry the instruction 'Do not add rules here'. They are the RECEIPT classes for routing work units; this file constrains the decision payload itself and is deliberately separate so nothing here has to be regenerated by platform/lib/_gen_schema_substrate.py. Hand-editing a generated shim to host these rules would be edited-in-the-wrong-place drift.

fits.description: false means NO capability cleared the bar. `fallback` is then required and `injected_bytes` MUST be 0 - an abstention that still costs context is not an abstention.

confidence_band.description: Sherman-Kent band paired with the number (AGENTS.md 7), so a bare 0.62 cannot be read as 'probably right' without its calibrated label.

injected_bytes.description: MEASURED len(payload.encode('utf-8')) of the cards actually injected. The anti-flooding accounting reads this, never an estimate.

selected.description: Chosen capabilities, best first. Each carries the evidence for its own selection.

why.description: The spec's 'explanation of why a capability was selected'. Must name the lane that CARRIED the decision, not merely the rules that fired: a 0.15 class-hint presented as the reason for a similarity-driven pick is misleading even when every token in it is true.

evidence.description: The LITERAL matched span. A rule hit with no quotable evidence is a similarity score wearing a rule's name.

conflicts.description: Audit trail of every demotion or suppression. Populated even when the outcome is unchanged, because invisible conflict resolution is unreviewable.

overrides.description: Parsed user overrides. A ban always beats a force on the same capability: a force-wins policy would let a habit phrase override an explicit refusal.

fallback.description: Required when `fits` is false. A structured capability-GAP record, not a shrug: metrics.capability_gaps() aggregates these to decide what to build next.

threshold_stats.description: How the selection cut was computed. Exposed because 'why did nothing get selected' is unanswerable without it.

allOf.$comment: An abstention must cost ZERO context and must carry its gap record.
A fitting decision must actually return something.
